selection.rule: first eight matching rows in original strict subset file order; no outcome or performance selection

precision: bf16-mixed trunk; native affinity autocast disabled (FP32); differentiable affinity autocast disabled

rng.formula: first 4 SHA256 bytes big-endian of namespace|base_seed|record_id, modulo 2147483647
rng.capture: seed each singleton native predict immediately before execution; independent of restart and prior records
rng.replay: restore separately captured CPU/CUDA RNG at each member invocation on every training and prediction pass
rng.historical_comparability: new per-record RNG stream, deliberately distinct from old seed42 sequential caches; not historical bitwise continuation

training.binary_policy: freeze affinity_out_mlp, to_affinity_pred_score, to_affinity_logits_binary parameters in both members; upstream LoRA may change binary outputs
training.loss: sum_i w_i smooth_l1(6 - (native_member1_i + native_member2_i)/2, assay_pEC50_i, beta=0.5) / sum_i w_i
training.weight: w_i = 1/max(pEC50_standard_error_i,0.1); nonfinite or nonpositive SE fails
training.conversion: native log10(IC50/uM) -> 6-native; adapted regression target is cellular pEC50, not a claim of native cellular endpoint support
training.records: all eight; one full weighted gradient accumulation per step; no selection, calibration, heldout evaluation or efficacy claim
